title: String Rotation Check
statement:
String B is a rotation of string A if B can be obtained by rotating A some number of positions to the left or right.

For example, "erbottl" is a rotation of "bottler" (rotate left by 3: "ler" moves to front giving "lerbott"... actually: rotate left by 4: "bottler" → "tlerbot"... use substring check: B is a rotation of A iff B is a substring of A+A).

Given two strings A and B, print "Yes" if B is a rotation of A, otherwise print "No".
constraints:
1 <= |A|, |B| <= 10^5
A and B contain only lowercase English letters.
inputFormat: Two lines: the first contains A, the second contains B.
outputFormat: Print "Yes" if B is a rotation of A, otherwise "No".
